name: com.fixmyepub/kindle-epub
title: FixMyEPUB
description: Send to Kindle troubleshooting, EPUBCheck error help, Kindle EPUB limits and fixed-layout code.

tools.name: find_epub_fix
tools.description: Given a Kindle or EPUB problem (rejected by Send to Kindle, no cover, want a new cover, file too large, wrong title or author, or validate before sending), returns the free FixMyEPUB tool that fixes it and a link. The tools run in the reader's browser; the book is never uploaded.

problem.description: rejected | no_cover | change_cover | too_large | wrong_title_author | validate

tools.name: send_to_kindle_troubleshoot
tools.description: Diagnoses an Amazon Send to Kindle problem from its symptom and returns the most likely cause, what to do next and a guide link. Same decision rules as fixmyepub.com/tools/send-to-kindle-troubleshooter/.

symptom.description: failed = upload failed or Amazon rejected the file; processing = stuck processing; missing = Amazon says In library but the book cannot be found; cover = arrived without a cover; unavailable = "temporarily unavailable" message

elapsed.description: Time since sending: under15, under60 (15–60 min), day (1–24 h), overday

other_epub_works.description: Does another EPUB arrive normally through the same account and route?

in_cloud_library.description: Is the book listed in the Amazon Content Library online?

tools.name: explain_epub_error
tools.description: Explains an EPUBCheck code or validation message (for example PKG-007, RSC-005, OPF-003) or a Kindle conversion error: which layer of the EPUB is broken, why, and the repair steps in order.

message.description: The error code or the full message text

tools.name: kindle_epub_limits
tools.description: Facts about sending EPUB files to Kindle: size limits per route, cover requirements, DRM, and what Kindle reads from the EPUB (title, author, cover metadata).

tools.name: generate_fixed_layout_code
tools.description: Generates EPUB 3 fixed-layout (pre-paginated) package metadata, the XHTML viewport tag and page CSS for a page size in pixels.

width.description: Page width in CSS pixels, e.g. 1200

height.description: Page height in CSS pixels, e.g. 1600
